contracts.boundary: The secret scan boundary self-test uses a stable synthetic value and isolates temporary Git fixtures from signing and hooks.
contracts.assertions: The pinned Gitleaks detector first detects the chosen fixture; side-branch and merge-only additions remain detected, and pre-base exclusions and injected merge-enumeration failures remain checked. Failure diagnostics expose counts and exit statuses only.

boundaryTest.exception: The Gitleaks boundary self-test is a shell script executed directly in the secrets CI job; it does not emit Node test events.

invariant.name: pins every external action reference to a full commit SHA

fault.exception: The executable boundary script injects a failing git rev-list and requires its failure to propagate; its secret-detection controls require Gitleaks to exit 2.

contracts.boundary: Provide a separate, main-base-bound integration declaration while retaining per-change evidence for v2.
contracts.assertions: Preflight selects by the event base and requires exact diff coverage including the changed non-selected declaration. The release declaration separately records named subsystem witnesses and explicit coverage gaps. The owned release caller excludes the selected declaration itself from the declared changed-file set.

boundaryTest.name: selects exactly one fixed declaration by event base and covers a changed non-selected manifest

invariant.name: keeps a changed non-selected declaration in the real selected-manifest diff

fault.name: fault control: selecting HEAD parent instead of event.before turns push base RED
